substantiveSelectorConclusions.conclusion: Absent EnabledByDefault remains unspecified, distinct from explicit false. Default enablement depends on engine/project origin and the engine-default allowance. Installed, Hidden, beta/experimental and content flags do not themselves establish activation.

Rows1-5 use bIsPluginExtension=true and are child-extension records. IsPluginExtension is absent. Extension discovery/merging is separate from ordinary plugin membership. Supported-platform lists retain their literal ordering; absent HasExplicitPlatforms must not be replaced with true.

Module host type, platform/architecture, target/configuration, program and loading-phase conditions were interpreted separately. Missing LoadingPhase uses the declared Default argument. None does not imply normal phase loading. EditorNoCommandlet and RuntimeNoCommandlet retain commandlet conditions. Empty Modules arrays represent no declared modules.

Runtime and UBT list semantics were kept distinct: the UBT module reader preserves an absent PlatformAllowList as null and treats a present empty list as excluding platforms. Program lists do not become Editor-target filters. Literal ProgramAllowlist, top-level PlatformAllowList, EditorOnly and other custom spellings were preserved without silently renaming them into reader fields.

ExplicitlyLoaded=true at row288 remains distinct from false and absence. Normal enabled-plugin processing excludes explicitly loaded plugins. Neither catalog inclusion nor selected245 membership proves actual startup, explicit loading or module activation.
